name: opencode-cliproxyapi-auth
description: OpenCode authentication plugin for CLIProxyAPI with /connect command and dynamic model fetching

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/models.test.mjs test/normalizer.test.mjs test/models-json.test.mjs test/models-dev.test.mjs test/logger.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && CLIPROXY_INTEGRATION=1 node --test test/integration.test.mjs
scripts.check:exports: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then((m)=>{if(typeof m.default!=='function'){throw new Error('Default export must be a function');}for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(m)){if(typeof value!=='function'){throw new Error('Root export '+key+' must be a function to satisfy plugin loader constraints');}}})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check:exports

author: Ruslan Gainanov
